faqs.q: Sec. 102-107. - Water conserving landscape incentive payment.
faqs.a:
So long as program funds are appropriated and available and the city offers the program,
               any property owner, contractor or developer who meets all of the following conditions
               of the city's water conserving landscape incentive program is entitled to receive
               reimbursement of expenses up to a maximum of $750.00 per water tap as specified herein:
(1)
Completes and submits to the city on a form supplied by the city an application to
                  participate in the program, and receives from the city notice of acceptance into the
                  program.
(2)
Submits to the city receipts evidencing the expenses paid in performing this water
                  conserving landscape work. The city shall only reimburse expenses actually paid up
                  to a maximum of $750.00 per water tap serving the landscaped property. The reimbursement
                  of expenses offered through this program shall only be paid once regardless of the
                  number of times water conserving landscape is added to the property or ownership of
                  the property changes.
(3)
Meets the city's criteria for participation in the program including the kind and
                  amount of organic material, if any, to be used. If under the city's criteria organic
                  material needs to be added, it shall be mixed with the existing topsoil and added
                  to the landscaped area. For purposes of this section, the term "landscaped area" means
                  the water conserving landscaped area in which the soil amendments and plant materials
                  are incorporated. The landscaped area shall be no less than 1,000 square feet. After
                  the soil preparation work is completed, the city or its agents inspects and approves
                  that work, and the city receives receipts for the expenses paid in performing the
                  soil preparation work, a reimbursement of up to $300.00 per water tap serving the
                  landscaped property will be made by the city. If the landscaped area is less than
                  3,500 square feet, the city's payment shall be a percentage of $300.00 per water tap
                  serving the landscaped property which shall be computed by dividing the total number
                  of square feet in the landscaped area by 3,500. For the soil preparation work, the
                  city shall pay no more than $300.00 per water tap serving the landscaped property,
                  even if the landscaped area is more than 3,500 square feet.
(4)
Submits to and receives approval from the city of a compatible irrigation system plan,
                  plant material list and water conserving landscape plan that meets the city's criteria
                  which shall include an annual water requirement of a maximum of eight gallons per
                  square foot of landscaped area. For new residential development, the landscaped area
                  shall be in the front yard of the property. The requirements of this section are in
                  addition to requirements of the city's zoning and other ordinances and regulations.
(5)
Installs the water conserving landscape material and compatible irrigation system
                  in accordance with the plans approved by the city.
(6)
After the landscape and irrigation system are installed and approved by the city or
                  its agent, and the city receives receipts for the expenses paid in performing the
                  work, an additional reimbursement of up to $450.00 per water tap serving the landscaped
                  property will be made by the city. If the landscaped area is less than 3,500 square
                  feet, the city's payment shall be a percentage of $450.00 per water tap serving the
                  landscaped property which shall be computed by dividing the total number of square
                  feet in the landscaped area by 3,500. For this work, the city shall pay no more than
                  $450.00 per water tap serving the landscaped property, even if the landscaped area
                  is more than 3,500 square feet.
(Code 1981, § 33-58; Ord. No. 2931, § 7, 10-19-1992; Ord. No. 2963, § 1, 3-15-1993)
